name: Okta MCP Server
description: Manage Okta users, groups, apps, policies and system logs from AI agents with Okta's official self-hosted MCP server, built for identity and IT admins.

skills.name: Manage Users
skills.description: Lists, creates, updates, deactivates and deletes Okta users, and shows which groups each user belongs to.

skills.name: Manage Groups
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes Okta groups, adds or removes members, and lists the apps assigned to a group.

skills.name: Manage Applications
skills.description: Creates, updates, activates and deactivates Okta applications, and installs apps from the Okta Integration Network catalog.

skills.name: Manage Policies
skills.description: Lists, creates and updates Okta policies and policy rules, including password, MFA and device assurance policies.

skills.name: Read System Logs
skills.description: Retrieves Okta system logs so an agent can review login attempts, failed sign-ins and authentication events.
